title: Arya Vysya Gotralu – Lineages of the 102 Rishis

overview.description: There are 102 gotras among Komatis called as Arya Vaisyas out of 714 gotras of Komatis. These lineages trace back to ancient Rishis and are used for identification, rituals, and cultural continuity.
